name: shaddai.md
text: SHADDAI is an AI agent marketplace with subscription billing and a workflow engine. Seven specialized agents form a council: SHADDAI orchestrates, NEXUS builds backend and infrastructure, ZEROX handles billing and revenue, ORACLE researches, TURTLE designs UI/UX, QUILL writes documentation, and PIKADON audits security. The workflow engine lets users chain agents together with goals and share results.
